caption: The drawing depicts a single, wide, circular band positioned horizontally near the center of the image against a plain, beige background. The band is divided into colored sections inside, consisting of pastel shades of green, pink, yellow, and orange. The outer surface of the band features a repeated pattern of star-like floral shapes outlined in red, green, and yellow, with additional smaller motifs of leaves and dots in similar colors. The outlines and interior designs are rendered with fine lines and light shading, and the entire composition is centrally placed with ample empty space surrounding the band.
title: Belt
